applicability: Client continuation of a displayed comparison and primary subject along one exact family-side-revision roster walk.
conditions: The admitted response agrees with comparison, candidate, selected subject/revisions, cursor, family selection, side/revision, guarantee and page scope.
The request still owns the current read sequence and is not an ordinary refresh.
A rejected continuation states failure and retains the coherent display; a whole-review refusal retains the existing suppression rule.
exclusions: Merging across subjects, tasks, history selections, generations or immutable-content conflicts.
Replacement reads caused by refresh or a changed question.
statement: Family accumulation admits only a successful continuation of the displayed comparison, primary subject and exact family-side-revision walk; refresh, subject/history changes, stale responses and late superseded reads cannot import earlier family context.
